description: OLP Modaraba is an Islamic financial institution listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, incorporated in 1987 as First Grindlays Modaraba and controlled by ANZ Grindlays Bank, which Standard Chartered Bank Pakistan Limited acquired in 2000, when the Modaraba became Standard Chartered Modaraba. ORIX Leasing Pakistan acquired it in 2016 and renamed it ORIX Modaraba; it was later rebranded OLP Modaraba at group level. It finances plant, machinery, equipment, vehicles and housing under Islamic finance structures, and operates from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.
